verified.name: 1X Technologies
verified.description: Norwegian-American robotics and artificial intelligence company developing general-purpose humanoid robots for home environments. The company is headquartered in Palo Alto, California, with manufacturing operations in Hayward and Moss, Norway.
verified.notes: Company was originally founded as Halodi Robotics in 2014 and rebranded as 1X Technologies in 2022. Total raised figure is based on Series A2 funding of $23.5M (March 2023, source 2) plus Series B funding of $100M (January 2024, source 2). Sources 0 and 1 refer to a different company: 1X Technologies LLC, a Wyoming-based wire and cable manufacturer founded in 2015, unrelated to the robotics company.
